evidence_visibility.artifact_scope: Local admissions/recommender evidence summary, not a public deployment proof by itself.
evidence_visibility.public_use_gate: Run python3 tools/portfolio_public_evidence_preflight.py before citing current local routes or artifacts as public evidence.
evidence_visibility.current_public_claim_boundary: Treat #/portfolio, #/reviewer, local QA routes, Story Desk, Create, Play, Replay, and artifacts/portfolio as local-only until the intended branch is pushed, deployed, and rechecked.
evidence_visibility.application_claim_rule: Do not ask public reviewers to start from #/portfolio or #/reviewer unless the preflight passes. If it fails, use those routes only as local verification targets and demo-video context.
evidence_visibility.historical_anchor_boundary: The 2026-06-08 live-gate files were local run outputs kept for provenance, not public links.

gold_set_categories: arbitrary Story Butler input and smalltalk

safe_application_snippets.resume_bullet: Built Tiny Stories, an applied AI story-game runtime that turns rough prompts into playable sessions using typed Story Brief contracts, live LLM generation, persisted sessions, and reviewer-only observability.
safe_application_snippets.sop_sentence: Tiny Stories is the project where I learned to treat LLM product behavior as an engineering system: typed contracts, live-gated execution, telemetry, failure taxonomy, reviewer evidence, and player-facing UX boundaries all had to work together before I could call a demo reliable.
safe_application_snippets.headline: Tiny Stories: a live LLM story-game runtime with typed contracts, evaluator traces, and reviewer-only observability.
